supersedes_for_interpretation: config/leader_mentions_registry_v1.json -- v1 ran as registered and is kept (Step 365)
owner_approval: 2026-10-16, in chat: 'yes use my email and finish A25 ... keep trying your best to make this happen'
why_v2_exists: v1's precision check (50 hand-read mentions, before any return) found 12% genuine business relationships: 14 of 50 were banks as lenders/underwriters, 10 were generic tools (Facebook pages, Microsoft Excel), 20 were bios, peer lists, competitor lists or false matches. v1 therefore tested 'mentions', and failed (holdout 12m -4.57%, p 0.047). The owner's question is about real relationships -- low-key firms doing business with the leaders. v2 keeps only mentions whose own sentence describes one. Every rule below comes from reading v1's precision sample; none comes from any return.

construction.start_from: v1's 9,340 new mentions (same leaders, same quarters, same 'first time in four quarters' rule)
construction.drop_financial_leaders: leaders whose as-filed SIC2 is 60, 61, 62 or 67 (banks, credit, brokers, asset managers, holding/investment offices). Insurance (63-64) and real estate (65, REITs such as Equinix) are kept.
construction.sentence_rule: fetch the mentioning document (SEC Archives, contact email from the environment) and extract every sentence naming the leader. KEEP the mention if at least one such sentence contains a relationship term AND no exclusion term.
construction.matching: case-insensitive substring, within the same sentence

precision_gate_before_any_return: a FRESH random 50 of v2's kept design-window mentions (seed 20261016) is hand-read and classified exactly as v1's sample (relationship / financing / generic tool / other). If the relationship share is below 50%, A25 closes as 'real relationships cannot be isolated from free filings text at scale' and NO return is computed.
trials: v1's T1 (126 trading days) and T2 (252 trading days), same decision timing, same matched same-SIC2 controls, same exclusions (leader's SIC3, ETNIC peers, liquidity)
pass_rule_per_trial: v1's: design mean > 0 with p < 0.025 AND holdout mean > 0 AND survives dropping the top 10 firm-events AND design mean > 50 bps
cumulative_search_note: Two new trials on top of v1's two and 364 steps. The filter was designed after v1's returns were printed; it uses only the precision reading, but a researcher who had seen v1's negative sign designed it, which is recorded.
